user.title: Set up Circuitry
user.description:
Circuitry is a visual automation editor for Home Assistant. It allows you to create and manage your automations using a visual flow editor.

Click Submit to add Circuitry to your Home Assistant.

init.title: Circuitry Options
init.description: Override the language Circuitry's own UI uses, independent of Home Assistant's active language.

lossy_import.title: Circuitry couldn't fully understand an imported automation

report_import_issue.name: Report lossy import
report_import_issue.description: Creates a Repair issue for an automation Circuitry couldn't round-trip losslessly during import. Called by Circuitry's own frontend — not meant to be used directly.

entity_id.description: The automation entity that was imported.
